steps.eval: (()=>{const f=__rhf.game.fishing; const m=f.meter; if(m.phase===1){ m.t=0.5/f.timing.speed-0.05; __rhf.press('primary'); } return 'phase '+m.phase})()

(async()=>{const f=__rhf.game.fishing; for(let i=0;i<400;i++){ if(f.encounter && f.encounter.phase==='bite'){ __rhf.press('primary'); return 'hooked at '+i; } if(f.encounter && f.encounter.phase==='approach'){ f.encounter.t=f.encounter.dur; } if(f.encounter && f.encounter.phase==='nibble'){ f.encounter.nibbles=0; f.encounter.gap=0; } await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,50)); } return 'no bite '+f.state})()

(async()=>{const f=__rhf.game.fishing; for(let i=0;i<1500;i++){ if(f.state!=='fight') break; const F=f.fight; F.fish.weight=Math.min(F.fish.weight,1.8); F.fish.legend=null; F.stamina=0.2; F.dist=Math.min(F.dist,3); F.state='tired'; F.stateT=5; __rhf.hold('primary', true); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,60)); } __rhf.hold('primary', false); return 'state '+f.state})()

(async()=>{const w=__rhf.game.wildlife; const P=__rhf.game.player.pos; for(let i=0;i<600;i++){ const b=w.birds.find(b=>b.mode==='swoop'); if(b){ const d=Math.hypot(b.x-P.x,b.y-P.y,b.z-P.z); if(d<26) return 'swoop close '+d.toFixed(1)+' t '+b.t.toFixed(2); } else if (w.birds.find(b=>b.mode==='carry')) return 'already carry'; await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,40)); } return 'no swoop, state '+__rhf.game.fishing.state})()

(async()=>{const g=__rhf.game; const w=g.wildlife; const out=[]; const V=g.camera.position.constructor; for(let i=0;i<900;i++){ const b=w.birds.find(b=>b.mode==='carry'); if(b && out.length<8 && b.t> out.length*0.5){ const v=new V(b.x,b.y,b.z).project(g.camera); out.push('t'+b.t.toFixed(1)+' ndc '+v.x.toFixed(2)+','+v.y.toFixed(2)+' d '+Math.hypot(b.x-g.camera.position.x,b.y-g.camera.position.y,b.z-g.camera.position.z).toFixed(0)); } if(out.length>=8) break; await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,30)); } return out.join(' | ')})()
